name: Command Code Usage
description: Token and cost usage of Command Code (command-code / cmd) sessions, plus optional credits and limits.

settings.title: Command Code API credits
settings.description: Off by default. When on, the plugin reads a Command Code API key (Orca secrets, COMMAND_CODE_API_KEY / COMMANDCODE_API_KEY, or an auth.json under ~/.commandcode, ~/.pi or ~/.omp) and queries api.commandcode.ai for your plan, limit windows and remaining credits. The key is sent only to that host; the offline session panel keeps working either way.
